pages.text: Mandrake is never a polite harvest. In the older craft, a mature root sometimes comes quietly and sometimes wakes as a shrieking creature instead, especially at night and under harsher conditions.$(br2)Witchery: Rewoven now restores that split more honestly: when the crop does awaken, the living root keeps nearby players sickened until it is killed.

Craft $(item)Earmuffs$() from leather and white wool before gathering a large Mandrake patch. Wearing them in the head slot now blocks the restored nausea scream, which makes repeated harvests far less miserable.$(br2)They also now blunt the first practical Banshee scream damage again and hush the current ghast-scream placeholder cues on the client, though the deeper old sound-muting behavior is still rough around the edges.

pages.title: What Still Remains
pages.text: The current port is strongest on the crop's summon-vs-drop branch and on the first practical protection loop: grow the crop, expect the scream, and wear Earmuffs if you plan to farm roots in quantity.$(br2)Exact scream audio flavor, custom Banshee scream assets, and the broader old sound-muting feel are still follow-up parity work, but the current cues are now at least pointed back toward the old ghast-scream family.
